title: people-ops recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad 2026-03-13
content:
People Ops - Recruiting Coordinator scratchpad (PST)
Date: 2026-03-13
Owner: Samira Patel

Top priorities for today:
- Ensure 3 final interviews for Backend Eng (req 2025-BE) are confirmed + interview packets sent.
- Follow up with candidates who received offers last week (check acceptance estimate + any pending paperwork).
- Clear backlog of calendar reschedules (esp. UTC-friendly slots for APAC candidates).

Morning quick notes (before 10am):
- 9:00am - Confirmed: Backend BE final loop for candidate "J. Morales" at 2:00pm PT. Sent interview packet and Slack reminder to panel.
- 9:15am - No-show: Phone screen with A. Nguyen (SWE Intern) - left voicemail + Slack message; candidate asked to reschedule for next week. Mark as "reschedule requested".
- 9:30am - Calendar: blocked 11:30-12:00 for offer packet prep (NDAs + comp sheet).

Interview scheduling (items to action):
- Candidate: Priya Desai (Backend) - panel availability conflicts: ENG lead only free 3/16 after 1pm. Hold tentative 3/16 1:30pm PT; send confirmation once manager approves. Linked note: GH-PR-314 (candidate eval).
- Candidate: J. Morales - final loop 2:00-3:30pm PT today. Reminder: panel will use Zoom link REDWOOD-HIRING-zoom-02 (already on invite). Confirm tech laptop needed? He requested remote whiteboard; added link to CoderPad.
- Candidate: T. Wilson - onsite declined (prefers remote). Replace onsite panel with remote TL+HiringMgr; update invite to include video instructions.

Candidate follow-ups:
- Offer sent: Melissa Hart (SWE II) - offer sent 3/10, follow-up 3/13 if no response. TODO: call at 1pm PT and send quick summary email with benefits doc.
- Offer pending: Omar Reyes - awaiting salary approval from finance (ticket JIRA-4821). Check w/ Finance (Liam O'Connor) for ETA by EOD.
- Rejections to send: two candidates from Data role - draft notes prepared in GH-PR-314; send by 3/14.

Tasks / To-dos (sprint-y):
- [ ] Send candidate feedback reminders to interviewers for yesterday's screens (names: A. Nguyen, S. Patel). Deadline: EOD today.
- [ ] Update the hiring tracker sheet with new cycle times for Backend reqs. (sheet link in Confluence).
- [ ] Confirm background check vendor onboarding for new hires starting 3/30. Reach out to Compliance.
- [ ] Prep offer packet template updates (equity language) - coordinate w/ Legal & Compensation (Maya Kim).

Notes to self / quick fragments:
- When rescheduling APAC candidates, prioritize 7:00-9:00pm PT blocks (morning there). Add note to calendar invites: "Please state your timezone when replying."
- Revisit scheduling template: include explicit buffer times between interviews (10 min) to avoid spillover.
- Use canned email for "no-show" that asks for best availability + reason; keep empathetic tone.

Blockers / Questions:
- Finance approval delay for Omar's comp. If not approved by 3/13 5pm PT, escalate to Sarah (Finance Lead).
- Background check vendor gave new form - need Legal review before sending to candidates.

End-of-day checklist:
- Confirm all invites for tomorrow have panel confirmations.
- Close out any "reschedule requested" statuses in Greenhouse.
- Update status board in Slack (#hiring-coord) with quick summary: 3 confirmed interviews, 2 offers pending, 1 reschedule.

Misc quick links (copy to outgoing emails):
- Hiring playbook: confluence: Hiring playbook v2
- Interview packet template: drive: /templates/interview-packet-v3.docx
- Zoom link (panel): REDWOOD-HIRING-zoom-02

Random notes (flow-of-thought):
- Remember to ask ENG leads if they want candidate homework changed to short take-home (30m) vs live coding.
- Check if new campus program kickoff impacts intern offers timeline (Maya mentioned possible earlier start).

---
Timestamped updates:
- 13:05 PT: Left voicemail for Melissa Hart; emailed comp summary.
- 14:10 PT: Panel confirmation received from Backend lead for J. Morales.
- 15:45 PT: Omar's comp still pending; pinged Liam for update (slack).

(End scratchpad)
